# Contributing

If you have a feature request or question, check out https://github.com/opensacorg/api-wicit-doc/discussions.

For issues, see https://github.com/opensacorg/api-wicit-doc/issues.

To contribute to the project, first fork the repository. Create a new branch (optional) and submit a pull request.

See the documentation for help getting set up. https://opensacorg.github.io/api-wicit-doc/
